meta.data_description_zh:
1. 國民營養健康狀況變遷調查(Nutrition And Health Survey in Taiwan ，NAHSIT) 營
養狀況是影響健康的重要因素，亦是國民健康重要指標之一，國民營養監測調查
則是瞭解國民營養狀況之必要作為。102-105年「國民營養健康調查」，主要目標
係以全人口為基礎之抽樣設計，規劃建立長期、穩定且即時之國民健康及飲食型
態監測系統，於102至105年間逐年蒐集建立穩定足量的全人口樣本資料，並且可
以使每個單年度能有具全國代表性資料，合併4年可產生具縣市代表性資料以供全
國營養及非傳染病政策制定參考應用。
2. 102-105年國民營養健康調查內容包括受訪者基本人口學資料、飲食攝取資料、疾
病及環境暴露資料、健康風險行為資料、家族疾病史資料、ㄧ般體位及身體檢查
、血液尿液等生化檢查。

meta.data_description_en:
1. The Nutrition and Health Survey in Taiwan (NAHSIT): nutritional status is an important factor affecting health and one of the key indicators of national health, and nutrition monitoring surveys are a necessary undertaking for understanding the nutritional status of the population. The primary goal of the 2013-2016 (ROC years 102-105) "National Nutrition and Health Survey" was to use a population-based sampling design to plan and establish a long-term, stable, and timely monitoring system for national health and dietary patterns. Data were collected annually from 2013 to 2016 to build a stable and adequately sized whole-population sample, so that each single year could yield nationally representative data, and combining the four years could produce county/city-representative data for reference in formulating national nutrition and non-communicable disease policy.
2. The content of the 2013-2016 National Nutrition and Health Survey included respondents' basic demographic data, dietary intake data, disease and environmental exposure data, health risk behavior data, family disease history data, general anthropometric and physical examination data, and blood and urine biochemical tests, among others.
